questions.question: NPK is a:

options.text: Sanitizer used to clean dusty leaves

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Fertilizer used for increasing fertility of soil**__.

• 
 **NPK stands for **

 
 
• 
 **N**- Nitrogen
 
 
• 
 **P-** Phosphorus
 
 
• 
 **K-** Potassium
 
 
 
 
• 
 All** plants need nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium** to grow.
 
 
• 
 **Nitrogen (N) **– Nitrogen is largely responsible for the growth of leaves on the plant.
 
 
• 
 **Phosphorus (P)** – Phosphorus is largely responsible for root growth and flower and fruit development.
 
 
• 
 **Potassium (K)** – Potassium is a nutrient that helps the overall functions of the plant perform correctly.
 
 
• 
 NPK increases** the fertility of the soil.**
 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c1a28e731fadd9279228c1cea2f8e988a3f790bf9ccc89c9b0f02c423b1609.png] 

 
• 
 **Fertilizer is a natural or synthetic substance **that is applied to the soil or the plants to improve growth and productivity. 
 
 
• 
 Th**e different types of fertilizers include:**

 
 
• 
 ​**Inorganic fertilizer**- Nitrogen fertilizer, Phosphorus fertilizer
 
 
• 
 **Organic fertilizers-** Agricultural waste, livestock manure, municipal sludge

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chief of the Indian Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) in June 2019?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Samant Goel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64e177b3c5c5cb81c12b3d5b5ddabaaf474cdad3d6098992ca6592786c8147d6.png] 

 
• 
 **Samant Goel** was appointed as the **Chief of the Indian Research and Analysis Wing (RAW)** in June 2019.
 
 
• 
 He has been appointed for a fixed tenure of **two years.**
 
 
• 
 He is a **1984 batch IPS officer** of the Punjab cadre.
 
 
• 
 He had **joined the RAW in 2001** and possesses rich experience in intelligence and operations.
 

 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c1a28e731fadd9279228c1cea2f8e988a3f790bf9ccc89c9b0f02c423b1609.png] 

**RAW (Research and Analysis Wing)**

 
• The Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) was **founded in 1968 **to counter primarily China & Pakistan.
 
• Until **1968, the Intelligence Bureau (IB),** was responsible for India’s internal intelligence and external intelligence.
 
• After the **poor performance of Indian intelligence i**n the war of 1962 against China and 1965 against Pakistan, the government felt the need for a separate external intelligence agency.
 
• **RAW provides intelligence to policymakers and the army**.
 
• Raw keeps **close eyes on the activities of the neighboring countries **(China, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, etc.) of India.
 
• The primary focus of RAW remains on** China and Pakistan.**

questions.question: Union Legislature alone can make laws on matters related to ______.

questions.question: ______ is also known as the ‘All India War Memorial’.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** India Gate.**__

__
 
• **India Gate **is also known as the** 'All India War Memorial'.**
 
• The India Gate is a war memorial** located in Delhi.**
 
• **Sir Edwin Lutyens** was its chief designer. 
 
• It was inaugurated on** February 12, 1931, by Viceroy Lord Irwin.**
 
• The entire arch stands on a low base of** red Bharatpur stone **and rises in stages to a huge moulding. It has the names of** Indian soldiers inscribed on its walls**, who gave up their lives in the Afghan Wars and World War I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Gateway of India**
 The Gateway of India is an arch monument built during the 20th century in Bombay, India. It was built during British rule and was inaugurated on December 4, 1924. 
 
 

 **Victory at Sea Memorial**
 The Victory at Sea Memorial is an Indian memorial constructed after the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971 which is dedicated to the Indian Navy. It was constructed in 1996. It is located on Beach Road, Visakhapatnam.
 
 

 **Rajghat**
 Rajghat is located in Delhi and dedicated to the father of the nation Mahatma Gandhi. It is located on the bank of the river Yamuna.

• 
 **Snakes** belong to the** vertebrates**, along with all other **reptiles and amphibians, mammals, birds, and fish.**
 
 
• 
 All these animals have an** inner skeleton.**
 
 
• 
 **Invertebrate and vertebrate **are the two groups into which animal kingdom is further classified.

• A software application used to access information on the World Wide Web is called a **Web Browser**. When a user requests some information, the web browser fetches the data from a web server and then displays the webpage on the user’s screen. 
 
• “**WorldWideWeb” **was the **first web browser **created by** Tim Berners Lee in 1990. **This is completely different from the World Wide Web we use today 
 
• Finally, in the year** 2008, Google released “Chrome” **and within a time** span of 3 years, **it took over all the other existing browsers and is one of the most commonly used web browsers across the world.
